sources.method: Reuse unchanged F124-AL first-admitted original structural graph builder with new cohort source IDs, then apply prospectively frozen invertible transformed src key and public demonstrations symmetrically to positive and negative labels. Evaluator alone applies true inverse after model predictions.
sources.relation_family: full-rank dense GF2 16x16 linear mixing with 16bit affine offset, OR two-round 8-bit Feistel network with nonlinear keyed round function; both invertible. Neither inside old F124-AL odd multiplication / triangular-OR learner hypothesis set.
sources.corruption: All 48 paired tasks per lane/phase have at least two independently chosen one-output-bit flips, identical positives/negatives. First vector additionally duplicates two input/output pairs, all noise outside source graph, never corrupt source truth.
sources.independent_support: Public paired bit demonstrations sampled from independent operator namespace, graph-key-disjoint where possible. No task label, operator string, source seed or oracle given to model. Source truth checked by inverse prior original causal oracle; old literal raw-key shortcut excluded.
sources.first_use: No DEV fit/retraining; store initial first-use outcome and never claim subsequent rerun independent.

Yggdrasil.hypothesis: Can an operator-agnostic affine GF2 bit-vector learner fit full 16x16 mixing from corrupted/duplicate public supports and transfer to independent dense held-out maps, and does it correctly fail rather than hallucinate an inverse on out-of-class nonlinear Feistel networks?
Yggdrasil.method: Generic bitpacked 17-variable Gaussian elimination with intercept on RANSAC 17-of-n public demo subsets; score candidate against all support via output-bit Hamming; require <=2 corrupted output bits and a unique lowest-scoring affine map, otherwise abstain (no source-specific operator parser, no labels, no oracle fallback). Hypothesis family deliberately excludes Feistel: report negative. Bound attempts <=160 deterministic subsets; repeat only on public support. Original AG eta .1 and 7 active/9 retained hard capacity unchanged.
Yggdrasil.fit: Max paired accuracy on TRAIN; ties fewer FP then fewer examples. Freeze before evaluating DEV; compare frozen AL odd-multiplication/OR learner, raw original, evaluator-only true inverse AG ceiling.
Yggdrasil.success: Per-family correct classification and exact source-map fit; abstention on Feistel is acceptable as honest out-of-class failure, not a success claim for general cognition.

Wingless.hypothesis: Final-state sibling candidate uncertainty can distinguish false positives in the original unmodified AK beta .5 one-packed graph traversal while respecting strict conservation of recovered 13–15-hop positives.
Wingless.mechanism: Use original beta .5 per-hop competition before one packed retained state/node; at final target node compute ephemeral top versus next candidate score margin from already-generated candidate rows, penalize only ambiguous terminal evidence by gamma*max(0,1-margin). Do not retain any second state, cache or fingerprint. gamma0 exactly original beta .5. No global score threshold adjustment.
Wingless.selection: Filter TRAIN candidates requiring >= beta.5 baseline long positive sensitivity, then maximize paired accuracy, minimize FP, tie gamma0. Compare under fixed normalized learned operator inputs.
Wingless.strict_heldout_gate: No additional long-chain FN compared with gamma0 on fresh DEV, plus strictly fewer false positives to qualify superiority; otherwise retain scientific negative.
